The reference documentation of the ICON-Land source code is generated with
[FORD](https://github.com/Fortran-FOSS-Programmers/ford/wiki){.external target="_blank"} from

- comments in the Fortran source code, and
- the markdown files in `doc/guide`.

This page covers the code documentation. For the guide you are reading right now, see
[Authoring the ICON-Land Guide](03_quarto_authoring.qmd).

## Building it

FORD and Quarto are both driven by one script in the repository root:

```bash
./build-doc.sh [-q] [-f] [-p] [-c]
```

| Flag | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| `-q` | quiet: do not print progress |
| `-f` | fast: skip the search index to save time |
| `-p` | pages only: skip FORD and render just the Quarto guide |
| `-c` | clean: remove `3rdparty` and the generated html |

The script installs FORD into `3rdparty/` on first use, preprocesses the sources through
`scripts/dsl4jsb/dsl4jsb.py`, runs FORD, and finally renders the Quarto guide into
`doc/html/page`. Open `doc/html/index.html` in a browser to view the result.

::: {.callout-note}
`doc/html` is listed in `.gitignore`, so nothing generated is ever committed.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
While working on the guide alone, `./build-doc.sh -p` skips the FORD run and is far quicker.
For an even shorter turnaround use `quarto preview`, described in
[Authoring the ICON-Land Guide](03_quarto_authoring.qmd).
:::

## Published output

The documentation is also built by GitLab CI and published at
[gitlab-pages](https://jsbach.gitlab-pages.dkrz.de/jsbach){.external target="_blank"}.

::: {.callout-note}
The CI job runs on a nightly schedule on the default branch rather than on every commit.
A change therefore does not appear on the published pages immediately.
:::
